data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘sceorh’ meaning ‘shape’ or ‘free’ and ‘leon’ meaning ‘lion’, Shirlene originally meant ‘free one, bright one’. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes courage and strength, reflecting the powerful image of a lion. The name Shirlene carries the meaning “Free one, bright one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shirlene usually hope their child will grow to embody free one, bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The meaning of 'free one' signifies individuality and self-expression, while the 'bright one' suggests intelligence and wit. Therefore, the name Shirlene is perceived as a symbol of personal freedom, independence, and brilliance. This cultural significance resonates with the current societal values that advocate self-reliance and individual recognition.
